verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so cross-device task continuation is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no session sync or cloud continuation, and no way to resume a task from another device or browser. The browser device-code flow at omnirush.ai/console is only an authentication step, not a way to continue tasks, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
